subject: BUG-235: co-op member can rewrite a teammate's player entry
description: In a CO-OP arena room a member can write another player's players.<uid> entry: flip isHost, blank online, spoof name. VS is unaffected (per-team rule restricts the players sub-map to the caller's own key). NOT simply fixable: the obvious rule was written and removed because _handleHostMigration (CoOpSync.js:810-812) changes TWO player entries in one transaction and the writer may be neither, so the rule would break host-disconnect recovery. The precise predicate ('every changed entry differs only in isHost') is NOT EXPRESSIBLE in Firestore Rules -- its map primitives are hasAll/hasAny/hasOnly/diff/size with no quantifier over a dynamic key set; Nancy confirmed no such pattern exists in the 1260-line ruleset. Needs a different shape: move host migration to a Cloud Function, or store host as a top-level hostUid field so migration is a one-key write. P3: co-op is collaborative, harm is nuisance not falsified results. Raised by Nancy 2026-08-29.
